title: Mixed Event — Scramble Fan Festival!

rows.Line: Nice to meet you too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hanasato, I heard that you're an idol...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm trying to become an idol who can spread hope to everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I hope we can become really good friends, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Uh, right... I'd like that too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yay! Thanks, Nene!
Let's do our best for the Fan Festival!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
She's so talkative...
I guess she really is an idol...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, she has a very bright personality. So much so that she's able to cheer everyone up around her.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: She's also a very hard-working girl. Despite being in an idol group, she's the only one without any prior experience working as one.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's using the Fan Festival as an opportunity to grow as an idol and catch up to her groupmates.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I still have to depend on them when we're on stage so...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But your determination's really commendable...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, that's not true at all!
It's always been my dream to become an idol. That's why I want to keep finding ways to get better at it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The others work really hard too and have actual experience as idols on top of that...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I need to catch up to them as quickly as I can!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I agree, so let's give it our all.
I'll help in any way I can too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
M-Me three...
I don't really know much about being an idol, but I'd like to help...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seeing how determined you are has lit something inside of me too... So let's do our best, together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, let's do what we can and make our Fan Festival performance a big success!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay, shall we get started?
Or rather, what does an idol need to practice?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well... Singing for one, but choreographing a dance routine and learning it once it's done... There's so much to do...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's right, idols have to know how to dance too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. Haruka and Airi are usually the ones who come up with our dance routines, so this will be my first time actually coming up with one on my own.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to do as much as I can by myself, but I've been having so much trouble wrapping my head around how to actually choreograph a dance...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
As much as I'd like to help, I don't know much about dancing or choreography.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I've danced before in some of our performances, but I'd hardly make a suitable teacher...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wait, hold on!
Kusanagi, don't your shows usually involve some dancing?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, a little...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-They do, but I'm pretty sure that what we do isn't something you'd see idols doing...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, I'm not the one who comes up with those dance routines. Rui... I mean, our director is a better person to ask.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, would you mind if I did ask him and your troupe for help...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sure, I'm guessing they'll be more than happy to help you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really...?! Thank you so much, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
U-Um, Kusanagi...
Would it be possible for me to join her?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, me too...!
I'd love to see how you and your troupe practice, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
I can't really make any guarantees...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I'll talk to my troupe about you guys.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you, Nene!
I think you just saved my dance routine...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That just leaves singing...
I hope practicing on my own like usual will be enough...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My teammates may be able to help you with that. They're all very good singers.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They might have some advice for you, so I'll ask if they'd mind helping us during practice.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You will?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Of course. Would you two like to join as well?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If possible, yes...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Me too.
These sort of opportunities are pretty rare so...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! I'll make sure to ask them later!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It'll also probably be good to get a head start on this. Assuming things work out, you'll be welcome to join us for practice three days from now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, practice with my troupe will probably be four days from now, so practice with your team will come first in all likelihood...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Understood.
Thank you so much, both of you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm really looking forward to this!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm stepping out of my idol shell for the very first time. I can't wait to see how everyone else practices!)
A few days later
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm Kohane's friend, Minori Hanasato! I've really been looking forward to meeting all of you today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Nene
rows.Line: Thank you for having us!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're more than welcome! Kohane told me all about you guys, so I've been looking forward to this day too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's give today's practice everything we've got!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: FYI, I'm not teaching you guys anything. We're just gonna have practice today like normal.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: U-Understood...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, it's the split-personality guy. But I guess we don't get Mr. Nice Guy today...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What are you looking at...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: N-Nothing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, don't be so mean to them...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
Shinonome looks scary, but he's really a nice guy underneath.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, what are you running your mouth off like that for?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: B-But...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree with Azusawa. Akito says these things, but is really a nice person deep down.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So there's no need for any of you to feel scared.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Still, this is quite a surprise.
I didn't realize that you'd be bringing Hoshino here today, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, we met when I was doing a street performance. After that, we started having lunch and even practicing singing together.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, you two already know each other?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, she's friends with Tsukasa's younger sister and is even in a band with her now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, him...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's like we already all know each other!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: By complete coincidence.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But is it true that you're an idol, Minori? What kind of stuff do you usually do?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, I am! I'm in a group called MORE MORE JUMP! and we're currently focused on making videos and doing livestreams online!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We even got to help put on an event at an elementary school the other day. We played with all the students and put on a show for them!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds really fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, MORE MORE JUMP!
As in Haruka Kiritani's group...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, that's right...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I knew it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You know Kiritani?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I've known her forever. We've been friends, and rivals, for as long as I can remember.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really?!
Does that mean you've known her since she was little?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm so jealous...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. It's no big deal, really.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But now I see...
You're the one she keeps talking about...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, nevermind!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, I can tell you more about Haruka when she was little later.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
When Haruka was little?!
Yes, please, absolutely!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, let's get started already.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
You guys good to go?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yes...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll try my best!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: First, we'll have you watch us to get a sense of what our performances are like. After that, we're hoping that you'll be able to jump in with us for a few parts. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, understood.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Yeah!
song00005_off_s

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh wow... I'm getting goosebumps just listening to them sing...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She was really good when we went to the Seaside School, but Kohane's such an amazing singer...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(No, it's not just her.
They're all amazing...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, so that's about our usual.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-That was incredible...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I thought so too...!
It felt so powerful.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. Thanks.
But some parts of it are still bugging me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
How?!
You guys sounded amazing just now...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We can't be happy with just this.
There's still room for improvement.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Shiraishi, you have a habit of rushing into the chorus, which is causing Azusawa to fall out of rhythm.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sorry, my bad!
I promise to be more careful!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And it's good that you helped Azusawa out back there, but it also caused you to fall behind during the next part. Just keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yup. Got it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're doing great for the most part, Toya, but your voice is sort of getting drowned out during the parts where we all sing together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I've been noticing that too.
I'll make sure to work on my volume more.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You guys really don't mince words with each other, huh? We never talk like this in my troupe.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This feels like such a new experience!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, wanna try singing all together now? No, wait, making you guys sing a song you don't know wouldn't exactly be fair...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then why don't you try singing the song you'll be performing for the Fan Festival?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, right!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, I'll start us off.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, we can't hear you.
You'll never reach the people in the back if you're this quiet.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You don't have to hold back here!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: O-Okay! Like this...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, there you go! Much better!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Shinonome is honestly a little scary, but he listens so closely and is willing to say what needs to be said.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (He reminds me of Shiho in a way...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh wow, your singing voice is beautiful...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Your pitch and tone are excellent too. If you raise your volume just a little bit more, I believe you'll have no trouble reaching everyone in the back.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That just leaves you, Hanasato...
song00002_off_sabi

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Stop.
You were late there just now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That sort of mistake is gonna cause a domino effect that ripples across the whole song. You have to stop it during the next part.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You were slightly out of rhythm as well. Try to stay calm and listen for what the others are doing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I like how your voice is full of so much energy! If you can learn to sing from your gut instead of your throat, it'll probably sound much better!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (This is incredible. They're giving me such good advice after singing for just a little bit. This is what Kohane's been doing all this time...?!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(But I want to get better...!
I can't let their advice go to waste!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Minori, how do you feel?
If it feels like too much, you can tell us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks, but I think I can do it!
Let me try that one more time!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay, how about we call it a day?
Great work today, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I learned so much!
It feels like I'm already a better singer after today!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're kidding, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I understand how you feel, Minori. We were all able to see and hear things that we normally wouldn't have been able to.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah. Thanks, you guys...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm glad we could help.
We'll be looking forward to the Fan Festival.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, we promise to be there to support you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hang on, does that include me?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Well, duh...
Did you forget that Kohane's gonna be performing?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So good luck, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hm? What's everyone doing here?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Today's the day Nene brings her friends over for practice!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I wanna see too! I can't wait to see what they're like!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <That's great and all, but try to keep it down, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: <Okay!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Welcome to the Wonderlands x Showtime practice session! I am the troupe leader, Tsukasa Tenma. Allow me to introduce...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay! Hi, Kohane!
Won-Won-Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hi, Emu! It's been a while!
This feels so strange. I haven't had a chance to talk to you at the Wonder Stage like this before...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, it's happening again...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, Hoshino and Azusawa already knew about us...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
True.
Hoshino came to see our show the other day and Azusawa's our number one fan.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's nice to see all of you like this again.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We've really been looking forward to today...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wonderful! We're glad to have you here today! And you're here to learn more about dancing, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But more importantly, Nene, why didn't you say that you're going to be in this event!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You really startled me when you said, “I want to have my friends join us for practice since we'll be performing in the Fan Festival together.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Because you'll want to come and watch.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! We can adjust our schedule and find out where it's taking place! Not only that, we'll come up with some good cheers too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And if you run into trouble, Nene, we'll be ready to yell “Charge!”, and rush up to the stage to help!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This is exactly why I didn't tell you guys...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Anyway, back to introductions...
I guess that just leaves you, Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
This is Minori Hanasato.
She's an idol.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hello! I'm Minori Hanasato!
It's nice to meet you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Nice to meet you too!
I'm Tsukasa Tenma, the troupe leader for this stage.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that's right! You're Saki's big brother, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, you're one of Saki's friends!
A friend of Saki's is a friend of mine!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you very much! I'm glad to be here today!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You're more than welcome!
Now then, this is Emu and Rui!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Won-Won-Wonderhoy!
Nice to meet you, Minori! I'm Emu Otori!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
And my name is Rui Kamishiro.
It's a pleasure to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, it's nice to meet you too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So let's get down to business. The three of you are here to learn more about dancing, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, the dance routines we usually incorporate into our shows are meant to go along with a script. Would that still work?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, good response!
So, let's start by getting you some scripts.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Today, we'd like you to participate in our show. You'll of course have a script in hand throughout.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: U-Us in your show...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we believe that learn-by-doing works best for all of us. We'll start after you've had some time to prepare!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And so, the princess, Nene, is sent to the dungeons after it becomes clear that she was meeting the prince...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After that, Hoshino, the sorcerer, appears with her familiars, Azusawa and Hanasato, to free the princess.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And that brings us to this scene's dance sequence. How do you see this scene unfolding, Hanasato?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: M-Me...?! Uhh... Maybe something that looks courageous? A dance that says, “We're here to save you, princess!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, wonderful idea!
In that case, it'll be good to include a step sequence which reflects their intentions.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, that makes so much sense!
Okay, if we make this a two-step...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So this is how dances are choreographed...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's so cool...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Usually, Rui comes up with some rough ideas and we polish them up as a troupe.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hanasato seemed very keen to learn more about choreographing dances, so he may be feeling inspired to teach what he can.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Way to go, Rui☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now it's time to put it into practice.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, let's give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <At this rate, I won't be able to meet the prince... What should I do...? Oh, hello there...>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
<P-Princess, I'm here to help...!
With my magic, I'll...!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <Oh, you broke the lock...!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <You're free now. Please, run.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Next is our dance scene.
Don't forget to stay in character.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, I'll try... L-Like this...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, that's fantastic!
You're off to a great start!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, but keep your chin up.
It's important to exaggerate each move so that the audience knows what you're doing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: R-Right!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Kohane, you're next!
We get to dance together☆

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
O-Okay, while in character too...
Here goes nothing...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, you're doing amazing!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, but if you wave your finger all waggle-waggle, like this, it might make you look more like the sorcerer's familiar.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Waggle-waggle... Like this?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
You were the perfect familiar just now, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Emu...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That just leaves Hanasato...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Your singing and dancing is excellent. I'd expect no less from an idol.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much!
But I'm having a bit of a hard time staying in character throughout this part...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
Focusing on your fingertips may be one way to overcome that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: My fingertips...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Each step of a dance, all the way down to the subtlest motions, are a reflection of the choreographer's intentions and how a character should behave.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that sense, our fingertips allow us to express how we feel rather easily, no? From joy, anger, sadness and even how confident we are in something...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That is why I believe it's very important to focus on what your fingertips are doing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...!
I remember being told the same thing during dance practices with my group...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Be it idols or actors, we seem to share the same fundamentals when it comes to putting on shows, no?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We really do...!
Okay, focus on your fingertips. Expressing joy, anger, sadness, confidence...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think we have a much better grasp of things now...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm glad we did this!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot. There's an effect involving large ensembles that I've been meaning to try out. Tsukasa, would you mind jumping over to the other side of the stage?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hold on, what do you plan on doing to them? Don't get too carried away...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: While Tsukasa draws away the audience's attention, Hanasato and the others can quietly appear! Wouldn't it be a nice surprise for everybody watching?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, that's it...
You had me worried for a second.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're actually being considerate of them...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Did you say something, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, nothing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, they must be Nene's friends☆>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hehe. It's great to see how focused they are too.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <No, Luka, don't fall asleep on us here...>

rows.Speaker: Len

Yeah...!
Thank you so much, everyone!
Fan Festival Venue

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa's performance was really something else.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, the others were pretty good too. They all found a way to get this crowd going.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I should've signed up for this too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, there you all are...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane...!
You were off the hook today!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. Well done, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Don't you have anything to say, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, she did what she usually does. Just stay focused for the next event, okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, is that how it's gonna be...?
Who was the showering with praise just a second ago?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You tell me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Quit laughing, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you, all of you!
I'll promise to do my best during our next event too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi, that was awesome!
Like, really super awesome!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks...!
I don't know what to say.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was a little nervous but it ended up being a worthwhile experience.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: S-So... How did I do...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really really really really super wonderhoy! I got goosebumps everywhere!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She's right! And we should expect no less from our songstress! Everyone was absolutely blown away by your performance!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I still have a lot left to work on, including some things I discovered today.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Still, I sang up there all by myself, so I feel like I took a big step towards becoming a musical actress...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (My heart won't stop. It almost feels like I'm dreaming too.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I actually did a performance all on my own...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, found her! Minori!
We've been looking all over for you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, hi...!
Sorry, my mind's still trying to process what just happened...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We all understand exactly how you feel. After all, this was your very first solo performance.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You do...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, and you did great...!
Like a true idol.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But there's still a lot we need to work on. We'll get started on that when we get back!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Eep...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It was still a wonderful performance. Your smile and optimism likely helped inspire hope in everyone that came to watch today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, true.
I can't give it a 100, but it warrants at least an 80.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know I'm still nowhere near you guys yet, but I feel like I took a big step forward today...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And I hope we can keep moving forward as a group!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm sure we will.
We wouldn't be “MORE MORE JUMP!” without you here, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, Ena, perfect timing!
You should meet Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Everyone, allow me to introduce you all to our star idol, Minori Hanasato!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
H-Hello!
My name is Minori Hanasato!
It's nice to meet you all!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Nice to meet you too! I'm Ena Shinonome. Airi's told me all about you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, me next!
I'm Mizuki Akiyama!
Nice to meet you, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
We saw your performance too!
It was so awesome! You really shined up there! Starting today, I'm officially your fan!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you so much!
W-Wait, my fan...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Of course! How can I not become your fan after seeing you sing?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll make sure to check out your old streams too! And when you make it big, I can say that it was all thanks to me!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, that's your angle...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, Minori, I almost forgot.
Meet Kanade and Mafuyu. They're also a part of our little music group.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Nice to meet you. My name is Mafuyu Asahina. Your performance today was incredible, Hanasato. I'll be sure to keep an eye out for your stream from now on.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, um... I'm Kanade Yoisaki...
I really liked your performance too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It was so... Bright...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (My dance didn't go as planned, and I'm still nowhere near everyone else's level yet...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I performed in front of a lot of people and even got praised for my performance... As an idol...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I want to keep practicing and keep spreading hope with Haruka and the others to all our fans.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright!
I'm gonna keep trying more and more and more!
